description: Names the chord a guitarist is holding from the fret on each string (standard tuning), lists its notes and returns a chord diagram. Use when someone asks "what chord is this?" and gives frets like x32010, 3-2-0-0-0-3 or "0 2 2 1 0 0" (low E string first; x = muted string).

frets.description: Six frets from the low E string to the high e string. Use x for a muted string, 0 for open. Examples: "x32010", "3 2 0 0 0 3", "8-10-10-9-8-8".

name: identify_chord
title: Identify a guitar chord
